usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing SDN vnet firewall rule in-place — change its action, source/destination, ports, enable state, or reorder it via `moveto`. Requires `SDN.Allocate` on the target vnet's zone path (`/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>`); SDN firewall must be enabled on the vnet. Use the `digest` parameter when making programmatic updates to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Tighten an existing ACCEPT rule to only allow TCP/443 from a trusted subnet

params.comment: Allow HTTPS from management subnet only

tips: Pass `moveto` alone to reorder a rule without changing any other fields — all other body params are ignored when `moveto` is present.
Use the `delete` param (comma-separated field names, pve-configid-list format) to unset optional fields like `dest` or `sport` rather than overwriting them with empty strings.
Rule positions are zero-indexed; fetch the current list first with the GET sibling to confirm the target `pos` before modifying.
Changes take effect immediately after the API call — no reload step is required for SDN vnet firewall rules.
Do not mix IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in the same `source` or `dest` field.
